sonnetLines: When the world is hushed and white,
And breath hangs sweet upon the air,
We trace a path of fading light,
A silent promise we must share.
Through changing moons and gentle years,
The warmth remains, though cold may bite,
Held close within the fading night.
Like scattered flakes upon the sill,
Our bond endures beyond the thaw,
A steady love that time can't kill,
Just let the moments softly blend,
Until this quiet grace shall mend.
